name: icloud-docs-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for listing, searching, downloading, and reading iCloud Drive documents.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check whether the Apple ID session is trusted and iCloud Drive is reachable.

tools.name: list_folder
tools.description: List one iCloud Drive folder (not recursive).

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download Drive files to the local cache directory.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Download a Drive file if needed and return extracted text.

icloud_username.title: Apple ID
icloud_username.description: Apple ID used to access iCloud Drive. There is no default.

icloud_root.title: Drive folder prefix
icloud_root.description: Optional Drive folder prefix. All tools are scoped under it.
